findings.observation: An enabled occurrence with a false condition reached Pending/plan guards despite an empty selected set.
findings.required_repair: Skip boundary guard for an empty selected/unresolved set; evaluate false conditions before incompatible-context obligations.

findings.observation: The copied operation executed a modified workflow scope helper because the local manifest verified only plugin resources and the main dispatcher version. A controlled forged helper produced a marker.
findings.required_repair: Bind and verify actual composed owned helper/reference bytes before helper loading/execution; retain separate plugin resource verification.

findings.observation: The operation manifest included arbitrary parameter defaults from unrelated packages.
findings.required_repair: Emit defaults only for the selected package closure and assert absence using a unique unrelated marker.

findings.observation: A valid source hash still allowed Python -I -B to execute a matching timestamp cache with different code in a controlled fixture.
findings.required_repair: Use a fresh nonexistent cache prefix before owned helper imports and disable cache writes; preserve existing cache bytes.

limits: Early review is not the mandatory post-check full diff review.
Controlled helper tampering is an isolated unit fixture, not a hostile native plugin or product-host qualification.
